# fw onboard

> Reference of the fw onboard command: Describe the workspace for agents and export MCP, OpenCode and Zed configs. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/onboard/

Describe the workspace for agents and export MCP, OpenCode and Zed configs

## Usage

```bash
fw onboard [dir] | fw onboard export <all|mcp|opencode|zed> [--dir <dir>]
```

## Aliases

`fw init-agent` runs `fw onboard`.

## Flags

| Flag | Argument |
|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<dir>` |

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
